label: Chimney Corner headland northern apex
point_definition: Northern apex of the southern Chimney Corner headland, bounding the beach/cove to its northeast; not the namepoint or engraved meridian.
identity_evidence: The long western coastal face terminates at this north-facing headland. Its eastern side returns into the beach/cove, with a coastal road inland and the north coast continuing toward the neatline. That sequence matches the original coast geometry. The native shoreline crosses the engraved meridian near the apex; the selected pixel follows the shoreline, not the rule. The point is fully drawn below the northern neatline, and the original WACO20 vertex is the local northern apex.
phase: Fresh northern-edge validation against unchanged TPS13; no fitting or selection use
